author: Hadestia
name: bot
description:
Perform specific task provided by an 'option'.

𝗢𝗽𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀:
`-list`
- get list of active sessions in the system.

`-help-decor <type>`
- toggle help command decorations by specified type. Type must be a 'gif', 'img' or 'none' for no decorations at all.

author: Hadestia
name: export
description:
Export database data by an ID.

𝗢𝗽𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀: (either)
`user, group, ban, command`

author: Hadestia
name: notify
description:
Send a notification to all groups or given by thread ID. Be advised that '|' is included between options and the content message.

𝗢𝗽𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀:
`-all`
- Sent to all group chats.

`@thread-id[s]`
- Sent to a given thread ID. use space for multiple IDs.
